title: The deed-in-lieu element set, the inspection and transfer tables, the AMIS, SCIS and ALS path and the transfer event are not specified for rwb-treatment
source: Legacy RWB-E3-012 sections 1 to 19 (04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md, heading RWB-E3-012); FSD S2 TDR, settlement and deed in lieu v3 A2.12 (A2.12.1 to A2.12.4); TSD S2 TDR, settlement and deed in lieu v2 T3.1, T4 DEEDINLIEU and T5.1; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DIL-16 to R-DIL-37; Business Requirements Program v4 section 5.9 (REQ-S2-006 to REQ-S2-008); Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 13, 41 and 42; Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-03, DP-05 and R7.2 s12
section: 3 Preconditions; 4 Flow; 7 Acceptance criteria AC1 to AC4; 8 Business rules; 11 Data; 12.3; 12.4; 12.7; 13 Solution plan
description: One combined row for the deed-in-lieu journey. (1) TSD S2 T3.1 stops at DF-TRT-033 and has no transfer price, no inspection outcome, no unlock answer and no asset reference, although R-DIL-13 sets the price and R-DIL-22 to R-DIL-28 read all four. (2) No source states whether the inspection and the transfer are held on the treatment row or in tables of their own, so a team adding either could add a second and a third place where the same asset is recorded. (3) No source names an event for the transfer completion: the catalogue gives the service one event (EV-10), and R-DIL-28 ends on ASSET_ON_BOOKS with AMIS, the core bank and the registration system involved. (4) The legacy data table reads v_ace_customer and v_ace_npa_asset directly and calls AMIS, SCIS and ALS in process; the connection matrix gives rwb-treatment no link to rwb-source-data and no REST call to an in-scope service, and the Work Package declares no external dependency, so the target path for those facts is unstated. (5) TSD T5.1 lists INT-03 core bank (ALS), INT-26 NLEADS and INT-34 ACE common but no AMIS and no SCIS interface, and the FSD names AMIS, CCMS and the Land Office only as integration points. (6) The decision code a deed-in-lieu step writes to the local record is named by no source although every acceptance criterion ends with the record written with the rule version.
evidence: TSD S2 v2 T3.1 (treatment fields DF-TRT-001 to DF-TRT-033, none of them a transfer price, an inspection outcome, an unlock answer or an asset reference) and T4 DEEDINLIEU rows R-DIL-16 ('AWAITING_SECOND_SIGNATURE | SECOND_SIGNATURE_GIVEN | OFFER_WITH_CUSTOMER_DIL'), R-DIL-22 ('WITH_FIELD_INSPECTION | INSPECTION_COMPLETED | ASSET_UNLOCK_DECISION') and R-DIL-28 ('Record the asset in AMIS, settle the debt and release the registration'); legacy RWB-E3-012 sections 7 and 11 (data table naming recovery_case, assignment, v_ace_customer, v_ace_npa_asset, treatment and document) and section 16 (TC-E3-012-01 to TC-E3-012-06); FSD S2 v3 A2.12.2 ('Integration points. Workbench, CCMS, AMIS') and A2.12.3.1 (VR-S2-012-1, R-DIL-28, R-DIL-16, R-DIL-18); Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 13 (S2 row: T and E to P3 and P7, E to S8, T to P5 and P8, N to ACE common, no cell for P1) and slide 42 (EV-10 TreatmentApproved, producer rwb-treatment, consumers rwb-comms and rwb-payment); Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-01, DP-05 and R7.2 s12
area: Contract and data: deed-in-lieu element set, inspection and transfer tables, ACE and external path, transfer event, decision code
owner_role: Tech lead of rwb-treatment with the S5 owner of the asset record, the P2 owner of the integration contract and the P1 owner of the ACE read
proposed: Publish the working read of ASM-B2-S2-007-1 to ASM-B2-S2-007-6 in RWB-S2-E3012-CON and apply it in RWB-S2-E3012-APP: the five deed-in-lieu elements on the treatment row and no table for the inspection or the transfer, the case status and the case task moved by the parent CaseWorkflow, the ACE customer and NPA-asset facts carried on the case signal with no view read here, the asset record, the documents, the AMIS record and the debt settlement requested through rwb-asset, rwb-document and rwb-integration and returned as facts, the transfer announced by no event of this service and the outcome reaching the case on the case signal, and the decision code taken from the evaluated package. Confirm with the S5, P2 and P1 owners at the wave 2 contract freeze.

title: The deed-in-lieu element names, their domains, their absent-until rule and the absence of a transfer event are not specified for the rwb-treatment contract
source: Legacy RWB-E3-012 sections 1 to 19 (04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md, heading RWB-E3-012); FSD S2 TDR, settlement and deed in lieu v3 A2.12.3; TSD S2 TDR, settlement and deed in lieu v2 T3.1, T3.2, T4 DEEDINLIEU and Appendix T-A; Recovery Workbench API Specification v4 (x-module S2); Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 41, 42 and 43; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DIL-13 to R-DIL-37; Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-03 and DP-05, R7.2 s12
section: 3 Preconditions; 7 Acceptance criteria AC1 to AC6; 9 State transitions; 11 Data; 12.1; 12.3; 12.7; 13 Solution plan
description: One combined row for the deed-in-lieu contract. (1) The five facts the contract has to publish — the transfer price, the inspection outcome, the unlock decision, the asset reference and the time of the transfer — carry no field identifier, no type and no list in the TSD, which ends at DF-TRT-033, and the API Specification publishes no treatment element for any of them, so the names in camelCase, the value domains and the absent-until rule are a working read rather than a sourced value. (2) The transfer price is carried as offerAmount (DF-TRT-007) in the representation while the rules call the quantity transfer_price, and no source states that the two are the same figure. (3) The asset reference is named on the ACE side only, as asset_ref of v_ace_npa_asset (DF-ACE-208), and no source states whether the treatment repeats it or that rwb-asset's own reference is meant. (4) The service is given one event in the catalogue and no source names an event for the transfer completion, so the contract must publish none and the consumers must learn the outcome another way. (5) The schema registry mode and the AsyncAPI document are named, but the payload of the one event is named nowhere, which is the reason this contract refers to the envelope of RWB-S2-E3003-CON instead of restating it.
evidence: TSD S2 v2 T3.1 (fields DF-TRT-001 to DF-TRT-033; DF-TRT-007 offer_amount and DF-TRT-010 valid_until are the closest published facts) and T3.2 (LOV-TREATMENT includes DEED_IN_LIEU, LOV-TRT-OUTCOME has KEPT, BROKEN, COMPLETED, CANCELED and DECLINED, and no list carries an inspection result or an unlock answer); legacy RWB-E3-012 data table (v_ace_npa_asset asset_ref, DF-ACE-208); FSD S2 v3 A2.12.3.1 (R-DIL-16 generate the documents, R-DIL-18 schedule the inspection, R-DIL-28 record the asset in AMIS) and A2.12.3.2 (field catalog stopping at treatment.installments); Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 41 (rwb-treatment owns treatments, contracts, settlement and deed-in-lieu agreements, plan timers in schema rwb_treatment) and slide 42 row 10 (TreatmentApproved, producer rwb-treatment, topic rwb.treatment.events.v1, consumers rwb-comms and rwb-payment) with no payload column; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DIL-29 ('Hold the transfer and raise a task to clear the title') and R-DIL-37; Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-01 to DP-05 and R7.2 s12
area: Contract: deed-in-lieu element names and domains, absent-until rule, transfer event, payload reference
owner_role: Contract author of rwb-treatment with the S5 owner of the asset record and the P3 owner of the case contract
proposed: Publish the working read of ASM-B2-S2-007-6 in RWB-S2-E3012-CON at v1: transferPrice, inspectionOutcome, unlockDecision, assetRef and transferredAt on the treatment row, the transfer price carried as offerAmount (DF-TRT-007), each element absent until its step has answered, no table for the inspection or the transfer, and no new event — the one event type of the service referred to as fixed by RWB-S2-E3003-CON. Confirm with the S5 owner of asset and the P3 owner of the case contract at the wave 2 contract freeze.
